competitors.difference: Freecycle is global and unstructured; our board focuses on hyper-local art exchanges with category filters and visual thumbnails.
competitors.name: Freecycle

competitors.difference: Nextdoor is a broad neighborhood marketplace; we specialize in art/supply swaps with no ads and a simple swap‑focused UI.
competitors.name: Nextdoor Marketplace

features: Create a listing with title, description, category, and optional image URL
Filter listings by category and distance (using zip code prefix)
Contact poster via prefilled mailto link
launch_strategy: Create a landing page on GitHub Pages and share in local art‑focused Facebook groups and community boards.
Gather early feedback from a pilot neighborhood and iterate UI based on suggestions.

marketing_content.social_post: 🎨 Introducing Local ArtSwap Board – a simple way to trade artwork, supplies, and crafts with neighbors. No accounts, no fees, just creative connections. Check it out and start swapping today! #LocalArt #CommunitySwap
marketing_content.tagline: Swap art, spark creativity – right in your block.

monetization.free_tier: All core features remain free, including unlimited listings and local storage favorites.
monetization.pricing_hypothesis: Offer a premium tier that allows image uploads (via third‑party image host) and featured placement for $2/month.

next_improvements: Add optional image upload via a free image‑hosting API.
Implement a distance calculation based on full zip codes using a public geolocation dataset.
Introduce a simple admin view to moderate inappropriate listings.
operating_costs: Current prototype: ₹0 within published free‑tier limits
problem: Artists and hobbyists in neighborhoods often have extra artwork, crafts, or supplies they want to exchange, but lack a simple, local platform to list items, discover nearby swaps, and arrange meetups, leading to wasted materials and missed community connections.
solution: A lightweight static website where users can post items they want to give away or receive, filter listings by distance and category, and coordinate swaps via contact forms, all without requiring accounts or server-side processing.
tests: Add a new listing, then refresh the page – the listing should persist via localStorage.
Apply a category filter – only listings matching the selected category should be visible.
Click the contact button – the default mail client should open with the correct subject line.
